verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a SaaS analytics product, since such tools can ship AI assistants or natural-language query interfaces. Nothing in the pack shows Plausible accepting natural-language commands. The Stats API takes structured JSON queries, which is a developer building block rather than this capability, and the AI-referrer traffic tracking is an unrelated feature. Probes for llms.txt, docs.md and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404.
